# EV Charger One Full Documentation

> Complete Technical & Compliance Manual for EV Charger One — Central Oregon's Certified EV Charging Infrastructure Network.

## System Overview
EV Charger One coordinates residential and commercial Level 2 EV charger installations across Deschutes County, Oregon. All electrical work is performed by licensed Oregon electrical contractors holding active CCB credentials (CCB #248910 network).

## Core Services & Architecture
- [Tesla Wall Connector (48A Hardwired)](https://evchargerone.pages.dev/services/tesla-wall-connector/): 11.52 kW continuous output on dedicated 60A breaker.
- [NEMA 14-50 240V Outlet](https://evchargerone.pages.dev/services/nema-14-50-upgrade/): 9.6 kW output on 50A breaker with required GFCI protection.
- [200A Electrical Panel Upgrade](https://evchargerone.pages.dev/services/panel-capacity-upgrade/): Main service panel heavy-up per NEC Article 220.
- [Commercial EV Hubs](https://evchargerone.pages.dev/services/commercial-ev-charging/): Multi-unit residential and commercial charging management.

## Rebates & Incentives
- **Pacific Power Oregon:** $500 residential cash-back rebate per qualifying Level 2 EVSE.
- **Federal 30C Credit:** 30% federal tax credit on total installation labor and hardware expenses.
